(Śuddhasattva)Rāmānujācārya
alias Lakṣmaṇācārya alias Digvijayam Embāvayyaṅgar, son of Śuddhasattvācārya of Kauśikagotra. Patronized by Nañjarāja, son of Vīrarāja a younger brother of Senāpati of Kṛṣṇarāja II of Mysore. See VKSN. Raghavan, His.. of Viś. Adv. Lit. p.. 65-66.

ASR. 3 (inc.). Extr. p.. 2-3. Mysore N. D. I. 518. Extr. p. 62. VORI. Tirupati 86-90 (inc.).

--Cc.. Gurubhāvaprakāśikā on C.. Śrutaprakāśikā or Tūlikā of Sudarśana Bhaṭṭa on C. Śrībhāṣya of Rāmānuja on Brahmasūtra.
See under Brahmasūtra.

--Puruṣasūktacaramārthaniṣkarṣa. MD. 17194. MT. 3696.
